toni (Design): quick design check — iterating on the compliance region picker. goal: make it explicit which regions default to Redwood-managed encryption vs. those available with BYOK. attaching mock. looking for accessibility, microcopy, and keyboard behavior feedback. mohit (Product): overall thumbs up. two asks: 1) ensure account-level default region is preselected but editable. 2) expand BYOK acronym inline (users often skip). kevin (Eng): implementation notes: on modern browsers we render a custom combobox; fallback to native select on older UA. for custom we must follow combobox/roving tabindex patterns and expose aria-activedescendant. candidate markup we can reuse: ```html
\n \n
    \n
  • us-west-2 — Redwood-managed key
    • \n
\n
``` we should also add an aria-live region that announces selection changes. samir (Security): copy precision: avoid ambiguous label "Encrypted". use explicit phrases: "Redwood-managed key (AES-256)" and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". change any UI mention of "key id" to "key reference" for clarity. also request helper copy indicating that audit logs will include the region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used. allegra (PM): UX question: if a tenant hasn't uploaded a key yet, show the BYOK option disabled with a tooltip linking to setup steps "How to provide a KMS key". disabled state should explain prerequisites and not hide the option entirely. toni (Design): agreed. new microcopy plan: in the dropdown show compact labels: "Redwood-managed key" and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". beneath control add helper text: "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used." helper text will be referenced by aria-describedby. mohit (Product): visual: use different badge backgrounds (e.g., slate for Redwood, indigo for BYOK) but not color-only. include icons: shield vs key. make sure contrast meets AA. kevin (Eng): accessibility bits: do not include helper text inside the listbox. Instead link it via aria-describedby on the combobox input so screen readers read it when focused. implement aria-live polite status: ```html
``` update text on selection: "Region set to eu-west-1. Using customer-managed key; audit logs will record key reference." a11y-bot: automated scan results: - combobox pattern present? please verify aria-controls/owns pairing. - aria-activedescendant updates on arrow navigation. - aria-describedby references helper copy. - keyboard focus ring visible and not suppressed. - badge text contrast >= 4.5:1. (Flags require manual review) samir (Security): audit log wording: prefer structured human-readable entries. example: "action: inference.request, region: eu-west-1, key_reference: projects/abc/keys/key-123 (customer-managed)" Ensure UI tooltip uses "key reference" to match logs. Also add a note in modal copy that key material never leaves customer control (if BYOK means we only reference key IDs). toni (Design): modal flow idea: when switching to Customer-managed KMS show a confirmation modal: title: "Switch to customer-managed KMS (BYOK)" body: "New requests will use this key. Audit logs will record the key reference. You must upload or grant access to the key to complete." buttons: Cancel / Continue. will include a propagation note and docs link. allegra (PM): propagation note = good. suggest text: "Changes may take up to 2 minutes to take effect across active workers." and include a small help link to troubleshooting. also track analytics event when users click the helper 'learn more'. mohit (Product): one more: when user hovers badge show concise hover copy: "Redwood-managed key: Redwood rotates and manages keys for you." and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK): requests will use your provided KMS key; audit will include key reference." keep hover lines short. kevin (Eng): testing checklist request: unit/integration tests should assert aria-describedby present, aria-live update text contains both region and key usage, and fallback to native select renders when feature-detect fails. Samir, can you provide an audit regression prompt set for CI? samir (Security): yes I'll add tests for: create request with BYOK enabled, change region, verify audit entry includes region + key_reference; also test disabled BYOK state doesn't expose key_reference until configured. toni (Design): punchlist I'll deliver in the next mock update: - dropdown labels: "Redwood-managed key" / "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)" - helper text: "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used." (aria-describedby) - badges: color + icon, not color-only - keyboard: combobox + aria-activedescendant + aria-live updates - modal copy + propagation note + docs link + analytics hook on learn-more - audit log wording -> use "key reference" I'll post a new screenshot and attach the updated copy in the ticket.
